report.explanation: All current read-only telemetry is healthy and contradicts the alert: checkout trace OK, error rates ~0.12%, p95 78ms, zero pool waiters and dependency timeouts across gateway, order, inventory, and payment. The order deploy (3.3.7, 499 min old, valid config) cannot establish causation. No bounded root cause is supported, so hand off for human review.
missing_evidence: No telemetry shows degraded checkout: order trace OK at 66ms, all services error_rate 0.0012 and p95 78ms.
No evidence of http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, or bad-configuration.
No latency/error baseline or time series to detect a real degradation trend.
